scope: Read all 59 source lines and actual N04bStateProfileType provider, including the exact affine radicand, original weighted state ball, smoothness tower test and the log exponent of an actual state direction.
At t=0 the true original ball and epsilon>0 supply a>0. The grading P is only nonnegative.
If epsilon*abs(b)>a*P, then b is nonzero and t=-a/b satisfies abs(t)*P<epsilon. The actual provider then gives positive a+b*t although exact field algebra makes it zero.
The argument never divides by the grading and remains valid at grading zero. It retains the actual original N01 neighborhood, state space and supplied witness.
Only available logarithmic-profile state directions are tested. This does not prove uniform simple-root kappa or license arbitrary profile perturbations.
